lifecycle_contract.output_bound: checked worst-case fixed-vector payload plus exception metadata; includes padded tail vectors
lifecycle_contract.error_codes: stable tscb_status_v1; forced ALP returns UNSUPPORTED instead of changing scheme
lifecycle_contract.reset: ABI reset clears object state and preserves native timing enablement

stream_components.outer_container: 12-byte versioned prefix plus canonical JSON buffer descriptors
stream_components.native_header: scheme, dtype width, row/column counts and vector size
stream_components.alp: rowgroup sampling plus per-vector exponent, factor, FOR base/width, FastLanes payload and raw IEEE exceptions
stream_components.alp_rd: rowgroup left-part dictionary and widths plus per-vector FastLanes right/left payload and left exceptions
stream_components.accounting: every physical byte charged exactly once; capacity and logical compression estimates are never charged

known_limitations: ALP and ALP-RD are separate AlgorithmIDs. ALP is forced decimal ALP and returns UNSUPPORTED when upstream sampling selects ALP_RD; it never silently changes identity.
Only homogeneous little-endian float32/float64 VALUE UTS and synchronous MTS without validity are registered.
The adapter uses upstream scalar FastLanes fallback kernels. SIMD-generated kernels, streaming, query and random access are not registered.
Three replayed safety patches bound float factor indexing, move decoder multiplication into the floating domain and enforce destination-integer range before conversion.
NaN payloads, signed zero, infinities and subnormals are bit-preserved; the upstream benchmark's weaker NaN-category assertion is not used as project correctness evidence.
Tail vectors are zero-padded to 1024 internally and all emitted payload/metadata bytes are charged; logical tail length controls reconstruction.
Formal evidence covers the real exchange_rate float64 dataset only and is not a universal performance claim.
LeakSanitizer was disabled under the host execution policy; ASan and UBSan passed.
